_comment: One entry per field. 'key' must match the field_key in Jacob's Helios account (lowercase). 'irrocloud_device_name' is the device name exactly as the IrroCloud website shows it — the morning discovery run fills these in. 'probes' maps probe letter to role: 'pivot' (under the pivot; used for the headline numbers) or 'handline' (in handlines; shown but excluded from the headline). REPLACE_ME means a human must answer. 'trigger_cb' is Jacob's irrigation trigger number in centibars; REPLACE_ME uses a placeholder of 50 and says so in every email.

fields.probes_note: One probe ('HLS') is in the handlines, not the pivot portion. Which letter that is comes from the morning discovery run; until then all probes are treated as pivot.
